problems.problem: The agent relied on external knowledge to state that Chris Farley was a member of The Second City, which was not mentioned in the provided passages.
The agent incorrectly declared that no evidence was missing and verified the claim, rather than identifying that the document confirming Farley's comedy troupe membership was missing.
The agent stated in its reasoning that no further retrieval was required because it wrongly believed the claim was fully supported in the first hop.
